killedBy: the Configuration body loads when its pane first opens (issue #1015) a load that fails is reported in the pane, and the next open builds the body in its place
why: Issue #1015. The Configuration load loses its rejection handler, so a failed load (offline, or a chunk name a deploy made stale) leaves the pane blank and becomes an unhandled rejection, which `boot.ts` treats as the match failing whenever a session exists. The criterion is that the failure is reported in the pane.
